SELECT r.PROJ_ID 
,d.DP_CODE as Discipline
,r.R_CODE as Requisition_no
,r.R_SUPP as Supp
,r.ACTUAL_IND
,r.MR_REVISION
,r.SR_REVISION
,R_ORIGIN_CODE
,rst.RST_CODE as Status--revision_id
--,decode(R_RELEASE_CONTEXT, 'ALL','All Quantities','SHQ','Shortage Quantities','SUQ','Surplus Quantities','CHQ','Changed Quantities','NLI','New Line Items')
,APPROVED_BY
,APPROVED_DATE
,ORIGINATOR
,REL_TO_PROC_BY
,REL_TO_PROC_DATE
,BUYER
,PROC_ACKNOWLEDGE_DATE
,INQ_COMPLETE_IND
,PO_COMPLETE_IND
--,R_ATTRIBUTE_1
,ORIGINAL_BUDGET
,replace(replace(n.SHORT_DESC,'|',' '),',',' ')as Short_Description
,replace(replace(n.DESCRIPTION,'|',' '),',',' ') as DESCRIPTION
--,m_pck_req_util.get_rnd_codes (r.rnd_id, '/', 255)
,MT.MTY_CODE
,MJ.MJ_CODE
,MTE.RTP_CODE
,mrn.rnd_code
,mrd.RSD_CODE
,CREATED_DATE 
FROM 
  M_SYS.m_reqs r, 
  m_sys.m_req_status rst,
  m_sys.mvp_er_workload  w,
  m_sys.m_disciplines  d,
  M_SYS.M_REQ_NLS n,
  m_sys.m_mto_types mt,
  m_sys.m_mto_jobs mj, 
  m_sys.m_req_templs mte,
  m_sys.m_req_nodes mrn, 
  m_sys.m_req_set_details mrd
where d.dp_id(+) = r.dp_id  
and w.r_id(+)   = r.R_ID  
and n.r_id(+)   = r.R_ID
and mt.mty_id(+)   = r.mty_id 
and mt.proj_id(+)  = r.proj_id --
and mj.mj_id(+)    = r.mj_id 
and mj.proj_id(+)  = r.proj_id --
and mte.rtp_id(+)  = r.rtp_id 
and mte.proj_id(+) = r.proj_id --
and mrn.rnd_id(+)  = r.rnd_id 
and mrn.proj_id(+) = r.proj_id --
and mrd.rsd_id(+)  = r.rsd_id 
and mrd.proj_id(+) = r.proj_id
and r.rst_id = rst.rst_id 
and r.r_supp in(          
(select  max(r_supp) r_supp from m_sys.m_reqs
where r_code =r.r_code
and   rst.proj_id   = r.Proj_id))
and r.proj_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.proj_id}'

oracleReaderQuery.value:
SELECT DISTINCT 
  r.proj_id, r.r_code, rn.description, r.r_supp supplement, decode(actual_ind, 'Y', 'P', 'I') inq_pur_ind, r.approved_date, rli.RLI_POS itemno, rli.RLI_sub_POS itemsub  
, i.IDENT_CODE ident, cc.commodity_code, i.input_1, i.input_2, i.input_3, i.input_4, i.input_5
, substr(UPPER(m_pck_std_custom.ident_desc(rli.ident, 1)),1,400) IDENT_DESCRIPTION
, to_char(rli.TOTAL_RELEASE_QTY) total_qty  
, to_char(nvl(rli.total_release_qty,0) - NVL(rli.last_total_release_qty,0)) increased_qty
, m_pck_req_custom.WEIGHT(rli.ident) unit_weight
, upper(u2.unit_code) weight_code      
, job_number accountcode
, upper(u1.unit_code) qty_unit
, dd.dd_code "Delivery Designation"
, rli.estimated_ros_date ROS_Date                                                       
, rli.tag_number  tag_number     
--, client_code 
, m_abb_pck_bom.ident_cc_layout2(i.ident,'L',1) "Long Description"
, nvl(rli.rli_comment, '') "Comment"
FROM 
  m_sys.m_reqs r,
  m_sys.m_req_line_items rli,
  m_sys.m_req_status rst,
  m_sys.m_req_nls rn,
  m_sys.m_jobs j,
  m_sys.m_units u1,                                                  
  m_sys.M_UNITS u2,  
  m_sys.m_idents i,
  m_sys.m_commodity_codes cc,
  m_sys.m_delv_desigs dd
WHERE 1=1
  AND r.r_id = rli.r_id
  AND r.rst_id = rst.rst_id 
  AND r.r_id = rn.r_id 
  AND rli.dd_id = dd.dd_id 
  AND rli.job_id = j.job_id (+) 
  AND rli.ident =  i.ident  
  AND i.commodity_id = cc.commodity_id  
  AND u1.unit_id = rli.qty_unit_id 
  AND upper(u2.unit_id) = rli.weight_UNIT_ID
  AND r.approved_date is not null  -- not needed Moses, 19-Nov 
  AND r.proj_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.proj_id}'
  ORDER BY r.r_code,r.r_supp,rli.rli_pos,rli.rli_sub_pos

sqlReaderQuery.value:
@concat('select prj.ID as [Project ID],
	   roc.ID as [ROC ID],
	   rocs.ID as [ROCS ID],
	   ',pipeline().parameters.p_pl_projectid,' [Project Number],
       prj.ProjectDescription as [Project Description],
	   roc.Code as [Code],
	   roc.Name as [Name],
	   roc.SubPrime as [Sub Prime],
	   rocs.Name as [ROCS Name],
	   rocs.Step as [ROCS Step],
	   rocs.Percentage as [ROCS Percentage],
	   rocs.IsDriving as [Driving?],
	   rocs.Qty as [Quantity],
	   rocs.QuantityDescription as [Quantity Description]
from [dbo].[PM_ROC] roc
join [dbo].[PM_ROCS] rocs
on rocs.rocid = roc.id
join [dbo].[PM_ProjectMasterData] prj
on roc.projectid = prj.ID')
